entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thanks for calling VeloFit. My name is Judy. How can I help you today?
Hello, Judy. I'd like to start a return for a helmet I purchased.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered about 82 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. I know it's been a little while, so I hope it's still possible to send it back.
Oh, that's **no problem** at all. You're well within the **90 days** we allow for returns. I can get that processed for you right away.
Really? That's fantastic! I was worried I missed the window.

Not at all! And I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you, I'll waive the return shipping fee for you. I've just sent a pre-paid **return label** to the email on file. Just print it out and attach it to the package.
Wow, that's perfect. Thank you so much for making that so easy.
It's my pleasure. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method. Anything else I can do for you today?
Nope, that was everything. Thanks again, Judy.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day!
